The [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Atlas">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] '''Vendara''' was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[near-Human]]s that developed from the descendants of an ancient colonization attempt made on [[Vendara]]. As near-Human,<ref name="Creatures" /> the species was similar to base&ndash;line [[Human/Legends|Humans]], however they evolved with unique adaptations to their environment.<ref name="Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref> According to their legends, the species hunted huge [[skeeg]]s, a type of predatory [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusk]], from the worlds [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] for their [[Foodstuff/Legends|meat]] as well as the creature's [[Perfume/Legends|perfume]] which they used as a [[Poison/Legends|poison]]. By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|time]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactc Empire]], the skeeg were much smaller&mdash;17 [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] long on average&mdash;and the creature's perfume was considered to be only a mild poison.<ref name="Creatures" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species was mentioned in a section of ''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]'', a [[1994]] supplement to ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[West End Games]]. The section, which was about the skeeg, was credited to [[Chuck Truett]].<ref name="Creatures" />
